oneOf.description: Sew's own model: roles, overwrites and membership are edited in Sew (the default).
The governing App decides membership, private channels and levels (K2's sync).

The server-governed Space (named `K5 Space`), one per K2 install, owned by `k2:server`:
K2's daemon decides its structure over mgmt; no App session ever reaches it.

description: A Space over mgmt: the answer of create and bind.

app_id.description: The App it belongs to; absent when not bound.

governance.description:
Who governs the Space's structure; absent for `sew` (`server` for the
K2 install's own Space, `app` for an App-governed one).

hidden.description: The Space is hidden. Absent when `false`.

manager_member_ids.description: The listed managers' member ids, in request order (each a member holding the role).

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

manager_role_id.description: The manager role, once a manager was listed.

title: MgmtSpaceResponse
